summary: This note is a short biographical entry on Hassan Hanafi, an Egyptian academic. It states that he was born in 1935 in Cairo, Egypt, that he is a professor who chairs the philosophy department at Cairo University, and that he is regarded as a leading authority on modern Islam.
one_line: Short biographical entry on Hassan Hanafi, Egyptian professor of philosophy at Cairo University and authority on modern Islam.
key_facts: Hassan Hanafi (حسن حنفی) was born in 1935 in Cairo, Egypt.
Hassan Hanafi chairs the philosophy department at Cairo University.
Hassan Hanafi is described as a leading authority on modern Islam.
